content:
For the perk found in Nuclear Winter, see Nuclear Winter perks.

“You must be part mirror!”

**Refractor** is a Perception-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Increasing Energy Resistance based on current Perception

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 2 | Gain Energy Resistance based on your PER. | 000CA99D | 

Refractor is not the only Damage and Energy Resistance perk in *Fallout 76*, and similar perks may be used instead of or in addition to it, including:

- Barbarian (Strength perk): Scales based on Strength - Damage Resistance
- Bodyguards (Charisma- Scales based on Charisma and number of teammates
- Ironclad (Endurance perk): Up to 25% more protection. Double if wearing a matching set - Damage & Energy Resistance
- Iron Stomach (Endurance perk): Scales based on Endurance - Damage & Energy Resistance
- Junk Shield (Luck perk): Scales based on junk + Luck - Damage & Energy Resistance
- Lone Wanderer (Charisma perk) Scales based on Charisma - Damage & Energy Resistance
